properties.entry: INSERT INTO EXPENSE_LOGS ( GTRANS_NUM, ACTION_USER_NUM, ACTION_TYPE, BEFORE_AMOUNT, AFTER_AMOUNT, BEFORE_CATEGORY, AFTER_CATEGORY, CREATED_AT ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())

SELECT L.LOG_NUM, L.GTRANS_NUM, L.ACTION_USER_NUM, L.ACTION_TYPE, L.BEFORE_AMOUNT, L.AFTER_AMOUNT, L.BEFORE_CATEGORY, L.AFTER_CATEGORY, DATE_FORMAT(L.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS CREATED_AT_STR, U.USER_NICKNAME, T.TRANS_MEMO FROM EXPENSE_LOGS L JOIN GROUP_TRANSACTIONS T ON L.GTRANS_NUM = T.GTRANS_NUM JOIN USERS U ON L.ACTION_USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM WHERE T.GROUP_NUM = ? ORDER BY L.CREATED_AT DESC

INSERT INTO EXPENSE_LOGS ( GTRANS_NUM, ACTION_USER_NUM, ACTION_TYPE, BEFORE_AMOUNT, AFTER_AMOUNT, BEFORE_CATEGORY, AFTER_CATEGORY, CREATED_AT ) SELECT GTRANS_NUM, ?, 'U', TRANS_AMOUNT, TRANS_AMOUNT, ?, '미분류', NOW() FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS WHERE GCATEGORY_NUM = ? AND USE_YN = 'Y'

INSERT INTO EXPENSE_LOGS ( GTRANS_NUM, ACTION_USER_NUM, ACTION_TYPE, BEFORE_AMOUNT, AFTER_AMOUNT, BEFORE_CATEGORY, AFTER_CATEGORY, CREATED_AT ) SELECT GTRANS_NUM, ?, 'U', TRANS_AMOUNT, TRANS_AMOUNT, ?, '미분류', NOW() FROM GROUP_TRANSACTIONS WHERE GCATEGORY_NUM = ?
